How to pay?

  • When you order: 25% of the website. For example €62.50 for a one-page website, €87.50 for a showcase website, €125 for an online shop.
  • When you receive the website: the rest in one go, or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments (commitment while you pay), and your plan starts. For example, for a one-page website: €187.50 in one go, or €15.62 a month for 12 months.
  • The plan: monthly, or yearly with 2 months free. You can change your plan and options whenever you like.

Your questions about the plans

What is the difference between Chico, Power and Titan?

Chico (€5 a month) keeps your website online and up to date on a quality server, with 100 Lia Tokens and one change by Alex every month. Power (€15 a month) adds SEO, to push your website up on Google, a faster server and fast support. You then get 250 Lia Tokens and two changes by Alex. Titan (€30 a month) adds a report on your sales and your figures every month, and goes up to 600 Lia Tokens. Your Lia Tokens pay for the changes made by Lia, between 30 and 65 tokens each, and for the tools in your client area. Lia makes the small and medium changes, Alex the bigger ones.

What if I need more changes?

For Lia, the Lia + option adds 500 Lia Tokens every month for €5. You can also buy a top-up when you run short: 100 tokens for €1, 500 for €5 or 1000 for €10. For Alex, there is the Boost: one extra change for €1, added to your next invoice. You confirm it with each request, from your client area, once the month’s changes are used up.

Lia or Alex: who changes my website?

You choose, with each request. Lia is the AI: it is done in 5 minutes. She prepares the change, shows you a preview, and only changes your website once you agree. Alex is me: I make the change by hand, within 72 hours, and I check it myself. I also check everything Lia does.

Monthly or yearly?

As you like. Monthly, you stop whenever you want. Yearly, you pay for ten months at once and 2 are free. You can switch from one to the other at renewal.

What counts as a change?

A specific change on an existing page: opening hours, a price, a photo, a text, a product. One request, one change. Unused requests do not roll over. A whole page or a new feature needs a small quote.

Are there any hidden costs?

No. The summary shows everything: the creation, the plan and the options you chose. Nothing else.
